items.title: What Does Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY) Trial Pause Mean For Its Pipeline?
items.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb (NYSE:BMY) has paused enrollment in its zola-cel cell therapy trials for autoimmune conditions following emerging safety concerns. The voluntary pause comes after inflammatory side effects were detected during ongoing safety surveillance in the program. The move raises fresh questions around the risk profile of cell-based therapies in autoimmune diseases, as well as the pace of Bristol Myers Squibb's clinical pipeline.
